The title of '''Potentate''' was held by [[Tambocell]], an individual affiliated with the [[Geroon Nation]], which partially shared its name with the<ref name="Endnotes" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and their [[Geroon|eponymous]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="OBF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Potentate was set to be introduced in the [[Ebruchi]] section of the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''; however, the quote the title was mentioned in was cut due to lack of space.<ref name="Endnotes" /> In the real world, a potentate was a ruler.<ref name="Dict">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/potentate|text=Potentate Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20221010143512}}</ref>
